safety_rules: verify exact remote repository and exact target commit
require current production commit to be an ancestor of the release
backup local environment, monitor configuration, state, build metadata and query snapshots before stopping the service
restrict backup directory ACL to the current administrator and SYSTEM
deploy with detached HEAD without moving the production branch
run the full Python test suite before service startup
generate and verify build-info against the exact release commit
automatically roll back after any post-stop failure
production_acceptance: GET /build-info reports the exact clean target commit
POST /api/v1/groupguard/query returns groupguard-query-delivery.v1 for shard and ARAM
optional lolban delivery verification passes when an operator supplies a test QQ
GET /api/v1/operations/query-observability returns query-observability.v1 and is not down
shard, hero and at least one ARAM payload snapshot exist after prewarming
completion_evidence_required: service build-info commit equals the pinned release commit

next_on_failure.summary: Keep the generated backup directory and deployment record, confirm rollback health, then diagnose the failed gate before retrying.
